tools.name: get_station_predictions
tools.description: Get real-time train arrival predictions for a transit station. Supports DC Metro and NYC Subway. Accepts a station name or an exact station ID; if a name matches several stations, the result lists the candidates to choose from.

tools.name: search_stations
tools.description: Search for transit stations by name or code. Supports DC Metro and NYC Subway.

tools.name: get_stations_by_line
tools.description: Get all stations on a specific transit line. Supports DC Metro and NYC Subway.

tools.name: get_all_stations
tools.description: Get the complete list of transit stations with coordinates for one city. Large result; prefer search_stations or get_stations_by_line when looking for specific stations.

tools.name: get_station_transfers
tools.description: Get transfer connections and nearby stations from a transit station. NYC Subway only.

tools.name: get_incidents
tools.description: Get current transit incidents and service advisories for DC Metro or NYC Subway.

tools.name: get_elevator_incidents
tools.description: Get current elevator and escalator outages. DC Metro only.

tools.name: get_bus_predictions
tools.description: Get real-time bus arrival predictions for a DC Metro bus stop.

tools.name: get_bus_routes
tools.description: Get all DC Metro bus routes with route IDs and descriptions.

tools.name: get_bus_stops
tools.description: Get DC Metro bus stops. Returns all stops or filters by lat/lon/radius.

tools.name: get_bus_positions
tools.description: Get real-time positions of DC Metro buses, optionally filtered by route.

tools.name: get_train_positions
tools.description: Get real-time positions of all trains on the DC Metro system.

tools.name: get_route_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a transit route including service patterns. NYC Subway only.
